- We require a W-9 and either a bank letter or a voided check for EFT changes. Looks like you attached the W-9 and the onboarding form — appreciate that.
- To change portal admin privileges we'll need the current portal owner to approve the transfer OR a signed request from an executive on file. If procurement@starlane.com cannot approve, a short email from your CFO or legal will do.
- For PO routing: once Finance updates the vendor remit details in the AP system, new POs will automatically send remittance instructions to the new email. Any outstanding POs created before the change will remain on the old remit address unless we manually reassign.

Ben — can you confirm the steps and timeline on your end? If the approvals and bank proof arrive by 12/15 we can target 12/22 for the system cutover so payments hitting after month-end use the new account.
